model_annotation: This plot illustrates the loss values over the course of iterations for several language models. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", uses a linear scale and ranges from 0 to approximately 140000, with tick labels spaced approximately 20000 units apart. The y-axis, labeled “Loss”, utilizes a logarithmic scale and ranges from approximately 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels spaced approximately 0.2 units apart. A solid red line represents Vanilla, initially exhibiting a loss value of approximately 3.2 at iteration 0, decreasing to around 2.6 at iteration 140000. A solid orange line represents StrmLMM with (n=64, H/T), starting with a loss value of approximately 3.3 at iteration 0, and declining to roughly 2.6 at iteration 140000. A solid brown line represents StrmLMM with (n=64), beginning with a loss value of approximately 3.2 at iteration 0, and decreasing to approximately 2.6 at iteration 140000. A solid green line represents SepLLM with (n=64, H), starting with a loss value of approximately 3.1 at iteration 0, reaching a minimum of around 2.5 at iteration 80000, and then returning to approximately 2.8 at iteration 140000. A solid magenta line represents SepLLM with (n=64, H/T), beginning with a loss value of approximately 3.1 at iteration 0, decreasing to approximately 2.6 at iteration 140000. A solid blue line represents SepLLM with (n=128), starting with a loss value of approximately 3.0 at iteration 0, and decreasing to approximately 2.7 at iteration 140000.
